crossRefs.note: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-Paneah. He gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife.…

people.name: On
people.line: An ancient Egyptian city, mentioned in relation to Joseph

people.name: Pi-beseth
people.line: An Egyptian city mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy

translations.web: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth will fall by the sword. They will go into captivity.
translations.bsb: The young men of On and Pi-beseth will fall by the sword, and those cities will go into captivity.
translations.kjv: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth shall fall by the sword: and these cities shall go into captivity.
translations.asv: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth shall fall by the sword; and these cities shall go into captivity.
